devin_customer: Hey support — toolcall failing with 400 invalid UTF-8 when path has emoji. Copy of curl and server response below.

maria_support: Can you paste the exact curl you used (including headers) and the raw response body? Also which SDK/version?

devin_customer: Using our in-house proxy + curl to repro. SDK is node-sdk v1.4.2.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/call_tool" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "file_inspect",
    "tool_args": "{\"path\":\"/tmp/emoji_%F0%9F%98%8A.txt\",}"'
  }'
```

devin_customer: Response: 400, body: "Unexpected token \u0000 in JSON at position 42" and logs show a UTF-8 decode error during parsing.

maria_support: Hmm the payload has both percent-encoding (%F0%9F%98%8A) AND the inner JSON string is double-quoted and has a trailing comma. Two suspicious things: (1) trailing comma in the inner string (2) percent-encoded bytes are being URL-decoded before JSON.parse which can produce raw bytes that break if decoded twice.

priya_engineer: Looks like our gateway does URL-decode on application/json bodies if Content-Type header is missing or mangled by proxy. Also the inner tool_args is a string containing JSON — double-encoding is brittle. Can you try a clean payload where tool_args is an object (not a string) and the path contains the literal emoji (UTF-8) instead of percent-encoding?

devin_customer: Trying that now. New curl:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/call_tool" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "file_inspect",
    "tool_args": {"path":"/tmp/emoji-😊.txt"}
  }'
```

devin_customer: This returned 200. So that confirms: double-encoded percent sequences + trailing comma in inner string caused the decoder to emit invalid byte sequences.

maria_support: Great repro — action items:
- Recommend SDK change: send tool_args as an object (avoid embedding JSON as string)
- We will harden gateway: stop URL-decoding application/json bodies; instead only decode form-encoded payloads
- Add validation to reject trailing commas in embedded JSON strings with clearer error message

infra-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-2214 — gateway URL-decode bug + validation improvement. Assigned to eng-infra.

devin_customer: Thanks folks! Saved my team a bunch of time :+1:
